title: Steam Awards 2026 add a Hall of Fame award 🏆
subject: steamawards
description:
Which past winner takes the Hall of Fame? 👇

The 10th Steam Awards opened nominations on November 23, 2026 with 14 categories, including two new ones: the Hall of Fame Award, picked from past winners, and This Is My Job Now, for games that simulate real jobs. Final voting starts December 17 alongside the Steam Winter Sale.

Sources: Steam on X (Nov 5, 2026), Critical Hits (Nov 6, 2026), 4Gamers (Nov 9, 2026)
Game footage © Bandai Namco / FromSoftware.

scenes.text: The Steam Awards are 10 years old.
Valve opened nominations on November 23, with 14 categories and two new ones.
The Hall of Fame Award picks the best game among winners from the last 10 editions.
Past Game of the Year winners include Elden Ring, Baldur's Gate 3, Black Myth: Wukong and Silksong.
The second, This Is My Job Now, goes to games that simulate real jobs.
Final voting opens December 17, the day the Steam Winter Sale starts.
